import argparse,datetime,hashlib,json,re,subprocess,sys
from collections import Counter
from pathlib import Path
from PIL import Image

ROOT=Path('D:/Physim');OUT=ROOT/'docs/visuals/f1-layouts/scroll-2026-10-21'
parser=argparse.ArgumentParser();parser.add_argument('--source',type=int,required=True)
parser.add_argument('--windows',required=True);parser.add_argument('--linux',required=True)
parser.add_argument('--windows-recheck');parser.add_argument('--windows-host-focus');args=parser.parse_args()
def read(p):return json.loads(p.read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
def sha(p,lf=False):
    data=p.read_bytes();return hashlib.sha256(data.replace(b'\r\n',b'\n') if lf else data).hexdigest()
def rel(p):return p.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix()
def work(platform,run,case):
    return ROOT/'build/native'/('Design-analysis' if platform=='windows' else 'Design-analysis-linux')/'test-results'/run/case/'files ä'
OUT.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
snapshots={str(n):read(ROOT/f'build/native/design-f1-source-{n}.json') for n in range(74,args.source+1)}
for bank in ('source_sha256_lf','foreign_sha256_lf'):
    for name,h in snapshots[str(args.source)][bank].items():assert sha(ROOT/name,True)==h,name
d=dict(created_utc=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),scope='F1 article and breadcrumb scrolling, overlay navigation rail and native input/reflow regression. No full H acceptance.',sources=snapshots,runs=[],references={},images=[],checks=[],build_failures=[],scroll_proof={},baseline_counterexample={})
old=read(ROOT/'docs/visuals/f1-layouts/kerning-2026-10-21/validation.json')
for name,h in old['references'].items():assert sha(ROOT/name)==h,name;d['references'][name]=h
specs=[(75,'windows','run-j8zyrf8l',4),(75,'windows','run-zha4pwx1',12),(75,'windows','run-aav4brgb',1),(75,'linux','run-hjpea_9g',4),(75,'linux','run-vi2u2mfj',12)]
if args.source>76:
    specs.extend([(76,'windows','run-gx_47mvr',16)])
    # The source-76 Linux run is supplied by the caller in an optional file.
    p=ROOT/'build/native/f1-scroll-prior-linux.json'
    if p.exists():specs.append((76,'linux',read(p)['run'],16))
specs.extend([(args.source,'windows',args.windows,16),(args.source,'linux',args.linux,16)])
if args.windows_recheck:specs.append((args.source,'windows',args.windows_recheck,2))
if args.windows_host_focus:specs.append((args.source,'windows',args.windows_host_focus,2))
for source,platform,run,count in specs:
    base=work(platform,run,'').parent;path=base/'results.json';records=read(path)
    assert len(records)==count,(run,'not terminal',len(records),count)
    d['runs'].append(dict(source=source,platform=platform,run=run,path=rel(path),sha256=sha(path),passed=sum(x['status']=='passed' for x in records),total=count,records=records))
for platform,run in [('windows',args.windows),('linux',args.linux)]:
    base=work(platform,run,'documentation_scroll');steps=read(base/'app-steps.json');output=steps[-1]['stdout']
    assert 'DOCUMENTATION SCROLL SELF-TEST: PASSED' in output
    d['scroll_proof'][platform]=dict(path=rel(base/'app-steps.json'),sha256=sha(base/'app-steps.json'),steps=steps)
    image_cases=[('documentation_scroll',f'docs-scroll-{case}-{state}.bmp',f'scroll-{case}-{state}') for case,state in ((0,'top'),(0,'page'),(0,'end'),(0,'find'),(3,'top'),(4,'top'))]
    image_cases.extend([('documentation_h','docs-h-00.bmp','h-dark'),('documentation_h','docs-h-16.bmp','h-light')])
    for case,name,label in image_cases:
        source=work(platform,run,case)/'workflow ä'/name;target=OUT/f'{platform}-{label}.png';im=Image.open(source).convert('RGB');im.save(target)
        assert im.tobytes()==Image.open(target).convert('RGB').tobytes()
        d['images'].append(dict(path=rel(target),sha256=sha(target),source=rel(source),source_sha256=sha(source),rgb_sha256=hashlib.sha256(im.tobytes()).hexdigest(),size=im.size,source_version=args.source,run=run))
    for theme in ('dark','light'):
        for kind,tool in [('title','check_f1_article_title.py'),('surfaces','check_f1_h_reference.py')]:
            report=OUT/f'{platform}-{kind}-{theme}.json'
            command=[sys.executable,str(ROOT/'tests'/tool),'--native',str(OUT/f'{platform}-h-{theme}.png'),'--theme',theme,'--report',str(report)]
            result=subprocess.run(command,capture_output=True,text=True);check=read(report)
            assert result.returncode in (0,1)
            if platform=='windows' or kind=='surfaces':assert result.returncode==0,result.stdout+result.stderr
            d['checks'].append(dict(platform=platform,kind=kind,theme=theme,command=command,exit_code=result.returncode,report=rel(report),sha256=sha(report),result=check))
for platform,label in [('windows','f1-windows-74.log'),('linux','f1-linux-74.log')]:
    p=ROOT/'build/native'/label;log=p.read_text(encoding='utf-8',errors='replace')
    d['build_failures'].append(dict(source=74,platform=platform,path=rel(p),sha256=sha(p),diagnostics=[s for s in log.splitlines() if 'error C2440' in s or 'error: incompatible' in s or 'Build failed:' in s]))
baseline=work('windows','run-6wl5fz5v','documentation_h')/'app-steps.json';output=read(baseline)[-1]['stdout']
line=re.search(r'DOCUMENTATION H GEOMETRY: case=0 .*',output).group(0)
aw=float(re.search(r'article=[\d.]+,([\d.]+)',line)[1]);bw=float(re.search(r'body=([\d.]+),',line)[1]);assert aw!=bw
d['baseline_counterexample']=dict(source=73,path=rel(baseline),sha256=sha(baseline),measurement=line,requirement='article viewport width equals the full middle pane width',rejected=aw!=bw,limits='Re-evaluation of recorded native geometry; not execution of the new fixture against an old binary.')
d['final_unique_scope']={}
for platform in ('windows','linux'):
    records=[c for run in d['runs'] if run['source']==args.source and run['platform']==platform for c in run['records']]
    positive=sorted({c['name'] for c in records if c['status']=='passed'})
    d['final_unique_scope'][platform]=dict(groups=positive,count=len(positive))
    binary=ROOT/'build/native'/('Design-analysis' if platform=='windows' else 'Design-analysis-linux')/'bin'/('physim.exe' if platform=='windows' else 'physim')
    for c in records:
        for s in c.get('steps',[]):
            if s.get('target')=='physim':assert s['sha256']==sha(binary)
    d['final_unique_scope'][platform]['binary']=dict(path=rel(binary),sha256=sha(binary))
d['rail_raster']=[];d['capture_parity']=[]
for platform,run,prior in [('windows',args.windows,'run-j8zyrf8l'),('linux',args.linux,'run-hjpea_9g')]:
    output=d['scroll_proof'][platform]['steps'][-1]['stdout']
    geometry=re.findall(r'DOCUMENTATION SCROLL GEOMETRY: case=(\d+) viewport=([\d,]+)',output)
    assert len(geometry)==6
    for case,values in geometry:
        x,y,w,h=map(int,values.split(','));spans=[]
        for state in ('top','page','end'):
            source=work(platform,run,'documentation_scroll')/'workflow ä'/f'docs-scroll-{case}-{state}.bmp'
            im=Image.open(source).convert('RGB');column=x+w-4
            pixels=[im.getpixel((column,row)) for row in range(y,y+h)]
            track=Counter(pixels).most_common(1)[0][0];thumb=[row+y for row,p in enumerate(pixels) if p!=track]
            assert thumb,(platform,case,state,'missing outer-edge scrollbar')
            spans.append((min(thumb),max(thumb)))
        passed=abs(spans[0][0]-y)<=1 and spans[1][0]>spans[0][0] and abs(spans[2][1]-(y+h-1))<=2
        assert passed,(platform,case,spans)
        d['rail_raster'].append(dict(platform=platform,case=int(case),column=column,viewport=[x,y,w,h],thumb_spans=spans,passed=passed,scope='Native rail at outer pane edge and actual top/page/end movement; no browser scrollbar-width equivalence claim.'))
    for case in range(56):
        paths=[work(platform,r,'documentation_h')/'workflow ä'/f'docs-h-{case:02}.bmp' for r in (prior,run)]
        images=[Image.open(p).convert('RGB') for p in paths];hashes=[hashlib.sha256(im.tobytes()).hexdigest() for im in images]
        d['capture_parity'].append(dict(platform=platform,case=case,source_versions=[75,args.source],paths=list(map(rel,paths)),rgb_sha256=hashes,equal=images[0].size==images[1].size and hashes[0]==hashes[1]))
d['limits']=['Foreign accessibility changes separately hashed; local builds are not clean-checkout proof.','Linux font remains different; no full-title or full-H parity.','No new interactive-browser or macOS proof.','Native screenshots contain the real documents; no replacement with the shorter mock content.']
filters=('documentation_scroll','documentation_h','documentation_detail','documentation_keyboard','documentation_window','documentation_history','documentation_panes','documentation_math','documentation_inline_math','documentation_zoom','documentation_density','documentation_font_demand','documentation_inline','documentation_typeset','documentation_navigation','documentation_sidebar')
d['commands']={'windows_final':[sys.executable,'tools/build.py','--config','Debug','--sanitizers','--build-dir','build/native/Design-analysis','--jobs','4','--test-display']+[s for f in filters for s in ('--test-filter',f)]}
wrapper=ROOT/f'build/native/run-f1-{args.source}-wm.sh'
d['commands']['linux_final']=dict(path=rel(wrapper),sha256=sha(wrapper),source=wrapper.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
d['build_logs']=[]
for p in sorted((ROOT/'build/native').glob('f1-*7[4-7]*.log')):
    if 'wm' not in p.name and p.name.startswith(('f1-linux-','f1-windows-')):
        text=p.read_text(encoding='utf-8',errors='replace')
        d['build_logs'].append(dict(path=rel(p),sha256=sha(p),outcome=[s for s in text.splitlines() if s.startswith(('Build failed:','Native tests:','Build complete:'))]))
cleanup=OUT/'cleanup.json'
if cleanup.exists():
    check=read(cleanup);assert check['status']=='completed'
    assert all(not (ROOT/item['path']).exists() for item in check['files'])
    d['cleanup']=dict(path=rel(cleanup),sha256=sha(cleanup),files=len(check['files']),bytes=check['bytes'])
d['generator']=dict(path=rel(Path(__file__)),sha256=sha(Path(__file__)),command=[sys.executable,*sys.argv],source=Path(__file__).read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
(OUT/'validation.json').write_text(json.dumps(d,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
print(json.dumps(dict(output=rel(OUT),images=len(d['images']),groups=d['final_unique_scope'],runs=[(r['run'],r['passed'],r['total']) for r in d['runs']]),ensure_ascii=False))
